What went wrong

What went wrong

Appium could not take control of the device: another automation client already holds it.

1msNewEnvironment issuesFailed

What went wrong

The app could not reach its API because the TLS certificate was rejected.

Usually device clock skew, which invalidates every current certificate. Check the device date and time before treating this as an API bug.
